define(['baja!'], function (baja) {
  // baja.rpc( in a comment is no call
  var note = "baja.rpc(ord, 'x') in a string is no call";
  function run(ord) {
    return baja.rpc(ord, 'webAndFox', 'a');
  }
  return { run: run, note: note };
});
